label: Tutorial: Create a bundle
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Create a bundle page (endpoint bundle.create). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Name and description
steps.text: The **name** is what people search for; the **description** (Markdown) says what the bundle covers, for whom, and how to deploy it. Add tags to make it findable.

steps.title: Visibility and next steps
steps.text: **Public**: everyone sees it. **Private**: only you, and whoever has its share link. After creation you add rules (search or pick from lists), organise them in folders, and attach documents.
